cases.name: Unsigned 16-bit
cases.observed_result: fs01_t03_unsigned_16bit_precision_and_highbit_rules PASS: canonical u16 12/16-bit admitted, non-canonical HighBit and dirty upper bits rejected.

cases.name: DICOM LINEAR VOI
cases.objective: Endpoints, midpoint, width one and rounding

cases.name: Rescale slope/intercept
cases.observed_result: fs01_t05_rescale_slope_intercept_ct_hu_and_negative_slope PASS: CT HU (slope=1, intercept=-1024), fractional, negative, and zero slopes verified without source mutation.

cases.name: Pixel padding

cases.name: MONOCHROME1/2
cases.observed_result: fs01_t07_monochrome1_vs_monochrome2_polarity PASS: final-stage 255.0 - y Monochrome1 inversion verified with immutable source samples.

cases.name: Invalid input

cases.observed_result: fs01_t08_invalid_descriptors_and_unsupported_profiles PASS: malformed strides/lengths, non-finite/overflowing VOI, multiframe, non-16-bit, colour/palette, and LUT profiles rejected.

cases.name: Budgets and overflow

cases.name: 2D patient plane
